feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
entry.summary: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

entry.title: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
entry.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

entry.title: Nearly two million people are behind bars in the US. How did we get here?
entry.summary:
Lynn Novick's new, four-part PBS documentary series, Crime and Punishment in America, goes inside the U.S. prison system and explores how
our approach to criminals has changed over time.

entry.title: Lindsay Clancy to face a new trial in spring of 2027 over children's killing
entry.summary: A new trial is set in Massachusetts against Lindsay Clancy as prosecutors seek a criminal conviction over the killing of her three young children.

entry.title: Air traffic controllers' union head on the nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks the head of the air traffic controllers' union what it was like for controllers as the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop.

entry.title: They saw people losing food benefits. So they started handing out free groceries
entry.summary: The cuts and changes to SNAP have been difficult for government workers who take pride in helping others. In San Diego, workers said they couldn't sit back while their neighbors went hungry.

entry.title: These birds fly 17,000 miles every year. Climate change could make it harder
entry.summary: Migratory birds cross the entire globe, carefully timing their journeys with the seasons. In a hotter climate, that timing is increasingly out of sync.

entry.title: Affordability was a key issue for midterm voters. It helped make childcare one, too
entry.summary: Childcare costs have surged, putting a major financial burden on U.S. families. Advocates say the subject once on the fringes of political debate became a major issue during the midterms.

entry.title: Flight disruptions expected to last into Monday
entry.summary: Congress recently gave the Department of Transportation $12.5 billion to upgrade the aging air traffic control system. President Trump wants more.

entry.title: Far from home. Voyager 1 is now farther than anything man has sent into space
entry.summary: NASA's Voyager 1, which is the furthest man-made object from Earth, is set to reach a new milestone this week. On Wednesday, the probe will be roughly 16 billion miles from Earth.
